title: Why is French cybercrime unit investigating Elon Musk's X?
summary: Elon Musk's summons ​for questioning by prosecutors in Paris is linked to a widened investigation into alleged offences linked to X's artificial intelligence chatbot Grok, abuse of ​algorithms and fraudulent data extraction. The probe is being led by the cybercrime division of the Paris prosecutor’s office. FRANCE 24's Delano D'Souza tells us more.
